# mifdlal.com

> Portfolio and services page of Mifdlal Tsaqib Alfarras: freelance web developer and AI automation specialist, working remotely from Bandung, Indonesia. The site's primary language is English, with an Indonesian version on the same pages.

## Pages

- [Home and portfolio](https://mifdlal.com/): short profile, six projects you can open, three services, work experience, education, certifications, and contact.
- [Project index](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/): every project with a link to its own detail page.
- [Service index](https://mifdlal.com/layanan/): every service with a link to its own detail page.

## Services

- [Websites and web apps](https://mifdlal.com/layanan/website-web-app/): landing pages, company profiles, e-commerce, up to POS systems. Handled from design through launch.
- [Chatbots](https://mifdlal.com/layanan/chatbot/): automatic replies and answers drawn from your business data, not fixed templates.
- [AI automation and workflow](https://mifdlal.com/layanan/otomasi-ai-workflow/): AI handles incoming messages, summarises customer context, and sends automatic replies.

## Projects

- [PT Loka Logistics Solution](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/loka-logistics/), logistics company profile site, WordPress: https://lokalogistics.co.id/
- [UT Bandung Exam Location Simulator](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/simulasi-ut-bandung/), six-step wizard app, Vite: https://simulasi-pemilihan-lokasi-ujian-ut.vercel.app/
- [Mahoni-House](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/mahoni-house/), bilingual villa landing page, Next.js: https://mahoni-house.vercel.app
- [Conduit](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/conduit/), video source extractor with an Express API and React interface, TypeScript + Playwright: https://conduit-iota-rust.vercel.app
- [E-Baso-Ikan](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/e-baso-ikan/), online fish-ball store, Next.js + Supabase: https://e-baso-ikan.vercel.app
- [Orbit CLI](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/orbit-cli/), project generator for seven frameworks, TypeScript: https://mifdlaldev.github.io/orbit-cli/

## Technical notes

- Static Astro site, served by Cloudflare Workers at mifdlal.com.
- The home page carries the summary; every project and service has its own detail page. Main content stays readable without JavaScript.
- Sitemap: https://mifdlal.com/sitemap-index.xml
